title: 第14章 生財有道第15章 让我生个孩子
content_zh:
“来几个人，帮忙剥皮取肉，最好生一堆篝火燻烤一下，这样肉不容易变质。”
听到楚夏的呼喊，双子和其他龙渊卫这才反应过来。
甚至都没等夏紫萱开口，眾人就纷纷上前来，在楚夏的指挥下將三头莽兽分解的乾乾净净。
这三头莽兽的体型都比较大，全部弄好，总共有七八百斤的精肉。
算是大丰收。
应该够楚夏吃上好几天了。
双子此时已经將火生好，甚至还就近採摘了一些香料，野葱，又从储物袋里拿出一袋精盐，化身厨娘，卖力的帮楚夏將莽兽肉醃製起来。
一旁的夏紫萱看的都莫名有些不是滋味。
她的这群龙渊卫，以前都是死忠於她的。
可现在他们却成了楚夏的走狗。
一个个眼里的崇拜之情根本无法隱藏。
虽然楚夏刚才连杀三只莽兽的手段的確很厉害，可我才是这里的主子啊！
夏紫萱无奈的摇了摇头，径直朝著皇陵深处走去。
龙渊卫门这才反应过来，还有正事要办，现在可不是烤肉的时候。
但火都升起来了，也不能丟下不管啊。
双子立刻叫来两名实力最弱的龙渊卫，吩咐道：“你两负责在这里烤肉，其余人继续出发，保护殿下安全。”
虽然莽兽已除，但难保皇陵之中是否还有別的危险，还是得谨慎对待。
楚夏依依不捨的看了一眼烤肉，最终还是跟上的夏紫萱的脚步。
皇陵內，树木遮天蔽日，不见半天阳光。
夏紫萱的脚步停留在一座陵墓的入口。

这陵墓建造在山体之中，里面空间很大，深不见底。
暂未察觉到危险。
夏紫萱来到了一座墓碑前。
墓碑上写道：大乾十六代皇后孟氏婉晴之墓。
夏紫萱沉默片刻后，便开始动手扫墓祭拜。
她没有要任何人帮忙，自己一个人前前后后忙活了快半个时辰才完成祭拜。
“走了。”
夏紫萱似乎没有太多留恋与不舍，完成祭拜后，便立刻转身离去。
……
回到紫月殿，已经是下午。
回来的路上，没有再出现任何风波。
楚夏也乐得清閒，坐在马车上吃了一路，肚子里塞了十多斤烤肉。
刚回来，他就迫不及待进入地下室，开始闭关修炼。
万神鼎吸收了三头莽兽的妖气后，吐出了大量灵气，都快把楚夏的丹田给塞满了。
content_en:
"Come with a few people to help peel the skin and get the meat. It's best to make a bonfire to smoke it so that the meat won't spoil easily."
Hearing Chu Xia's cry, Shuangzi and other Long Yuan guards reacted.
Before Xia Zixuan even opened her mouth, everyone came forward one after another, and under Chu Xia's command, they dismembered the three wild beasts cleanly.
These three wild beasts are all relatively large, and when all is done, there is a total of seven to eight hundred kilograms of meat.
It's a great harvest.
It should be enough for Chu Xia to eat for several days.
At this time, Gemini had already lit the fire, and even picked some spices and wild onions nearby. He also took out a bag of refined salt from the storage bag, transformed into a cook, and worked hard to help Chu Xia marinate the beast meat.
Xia Zixuan on the side looked inexplicably uncomfortable.
Her group of Long Yuan Guards were all loyal to her before.
But now they have become Chu Xia's lackeys.
The admiration in each of their eyes cannot be hidden at all.
Although Chu Xia's method of killing three wild beasts just now is indeed very powerful, I am the master here!
Xia Zixuan shook her head helplessly and walked straight towards the depths of the imperial mausoleum.
Only then did Ryubuchiemon realize that he still had business to do, and now was not the time for barbecue.
But the fire has been raised, so we can’t just leave it alone.
The twins immediately called the two weakest Long Yuan guards and ordered: "You two are responsible for barbecue here, and the rest continue to set off to protect the safety of His Highness."
Although the wild beast has been eliminated, it is unclear whether there are other dangers in the imperial mausoleum, so we still have to treat it with caution.
Chu Xia glanced at the barbecue reluctantly, and finally followed Xia Zixuan's footsteps.
Inside the imperial mausoleum, trees block out the sky and the sun is not visible for half the day.
Xia Zixuan's footsteps stopped at the entrance of a mausoleum.
This mausoleum is built in a mountain, and the space inside is very large and bottomless.
No danger is detected yet.
Xia Zixuan came to a tombstone.
The tombstone reads: The tomb of Mengshi Wanqing, the sixteenth generation queen of Daqian Dynasty.
After Xia Zixuan was silent for a moment, she began to sweep the tomb and pay homage.
She didn't ask for anyone's help, and she worked alone for almost half an hour before completing the worship.
"Gone."
Xia Zixuan didn't seem to have much nostalgia or reluctance. After completing the worship, she immediately turned around and left.
…
It was already afternoon when we returned to Ziyue Palace.
On the way back, there was no further disturbance.
Chu Xia also enjoyed her leisure time. She sat in the carriage and ate all the way, with more than ten kilograms of barbecue stuffed in her stomach.
As soon as he came back, he couldn't wait to enter the basement and start practicing in seclusion.
After absorbing the demonic energy of the three wild beasts, the Ten Thousand God Cauldron spit out a large amount of spiritual energy, almost filling Chu Xia's Dantian.
